format: NDCA amateur age classes (X.A.1 a-e, g)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Age classes other than Under 21 take effect on the actual birthday; a competitor moving up may change anytime in a 60-day period beginning 30 days before and ending 30 days after the birthday, extended to the last day of a multi-day Sanctioned competition when the 30-day mark falls after events have begun.

requirement: Competition OS does not compute NDCA age classes. The age_basis for NDCA amateur classes would record a birthday reference with window_before 30, window_after 30 and the multi-day extension as stated parameters; whether the window is a recorded election is unresolved.
enforcement_point: Not built. Design only (docs/competition/governance/editions/OD-30-rulebook-editions-design.md). The OD-03/OD-18 organizer determination is the only age-division control at first activation.
interpretation_notes: EFFECTIVE DATE UNKNOWN: effective_from is a schema-required PLACEHOLDER (the date the governance registry was introduced), NOT a verified effective date; no pinned source states one (OD-30 finding F-1). Window election and 'competitive events have begun' unresolved (OD30-SILENT-0002). Does not apply to Under 21 (OD30-NDCA-0002). Coordinates with NDCA-OD03-AGE-CLASSIFICATIONS (PR #837).
